metric_notes.collision_rate: Number of rows with collision=true divided by the number of result rows, in percent.
metric_notes.target_valid_collision_rate: Collision=true and target_fit - min_TTC < 0, divided by result rows, in percent. This follows the project's existing analysis rule; it is not a calibrated physical-distance metric.
metric_notes.target_fit: Internal search/ranking value; do not compare its absolute scale across scenarios as a calibrated physical risk measure.
metric_notes.aggregation: Compute metrics per run, then take the arithmetic mean across the three independent runs. No standard deviations or significance tests are generated.
